This gives normalised ABCD_e = (1/sqrt2)[[-1, j],[j, -1]] and ABCD_o = (1/sqrt2)[[1, j],[j, 1]], hence Ge = Go = 0, Te=-(1+j)/sqrt2 and To=(1-j)/sqrt2, hence S21=-j/sqrt2, S31=-1/sqrt2, S11=S41=0.
